annotations.title: Search wedding providers around any city

description: [Free] Searches wedding providers — venues, caterers, photographers, florists and more — around any city or place in the world, by category and free text — costs no credits and returns up to 50 providers with address, distance from the city centre, Google rating, review count and nyna page, plus how old the index is. `city` is any city, town or place name ("Aix-en-Provence", "Gardanne", "Bouc-Bel-Air 13320", "Istanbul"), resolved once and cached; only a name Google cannot place is refused. `category` is a slug from list_provider_categories; without one, the free text `q` is searched across every category. `q` matches names, specialities and cuisines ("halal", "turkish", "bastide", "château"): it is matched against indexed names, claimed listings (description, services) and the live Google search. `radius_km` (5–100, default 25) bounds the results; `sort` is relevance (claimed listings first, then nyna’s index, then live results), rating or reviews.

category.description: a slug from list_provider_categories; omitted = every category

city.description: any city, town or place name in the world, e.g. "Gardanne" or "Bouc-Bel-Air 13320"; adding the country helps for small towns

min_rating.description: only providers rated at or above this

q.description: free text: a name, a speciality or a cuisine, e.g. "halal", "turkish", "bastide"

radius_km.description: search radius around the city centre in km, 5–100, default 25

name: search_providers

charged.description: credits actually spent; 0 today for every tool

summary.description: one human sentence about the result
